newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian dollar dumped on Fraser comments.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian dollar dumped on Fraser comments.

text.p: The Australian dollar was sold sharply lower in United States dealing due to comments made by former Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) governor Bernie Fraser, traders said.

They said the comments by Fraser after the close of local Tuesday trade that the last interest rate cut in early November should have been larger led to speculation that the RBA might cut rates today. The RBA held its monthly board meeting on Tuesday and has cut rates the next day in a number of instances.
The Australian dollar was trading at US$0.7880/85 at 1930 GMT (6.30 a.m.) from its US$81.35/40 Tuesday finish.
"It all seems to be centred around the comments Bernie Fraser made yesterday that the last interest rate cut should have been greater," said a currency dealer at a major Australian bank.

"I think that sent a few of the guys in the States off thinking we are going to get an interest rate cut today. But a lot of the guys who have been buying it over the last three to four weeks have just decided to dump it," the dealer said.
